plain.li: [winter] Somebody let the fire die overnight. {OTHER_nameDef} says it wasn't {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: Lost the argument with {OTHER_nameDef} and got the pots. I'll be the best pot-scrubber this colony has ever seen!
{OTHER_nameDef} and I squabbled over the dishes, so I made up a song about it. I thought it was very good!

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} can't help snoring. I'll find something to stuff in my ears.
Bad night, thanks to {OTHER_nameDef}. {OTHER_nameDef} looked so sorry at breakfast that I didn't say anything.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} cost me most of a night's sleep. I've told {OTHER_objective} so, plainly.
If {OTHER_nameDef} wakes me again, I'll ask the council for a different room.

plain.li: [teen] {OTHER_nameDef} has been telling the grown-ups my business.

cheerful.li: Apparently {OTHER_nameDef} thinks I'm interesting enough to gossip about. That's something!

gloomy.li: The others have all heard what {OTHER_nameDef} said about me by now.
I trusted {OTHER_nameDef} with that. I won't trust {OTHER_objective} with anything again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} still has my comb. I'll ask again, nicely.
I don't mind lending {OTHER_nameDef} things. I'd just like them back eventually.

blunt.li: I want my gloves back from {OTHER_nameDef}. Today.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is ignoring me, so I've been extra friendly. It's driving {OTHER_objective} mad!
{OTHER_nameDef} won't speak to me. Very well, I'll talk enough for both of us!

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is freezing me out. I can wait longer than {OTHER_pronoun} can.
Two days of silence from {OTHER_nameDef}. Restful, in its way.

blunt.li: One more joke from {OTHER_nameDef} and I'll make one about {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} teased me about my hair, so tomorrow I'm making it even sillier!

gloomy.li: They all laughed at {OTHER_nameDef}'s joke. I laughed too, so they wouldn't see.

plain.li: [!lowtech] The dispenser jammed halfway through my bowl, and I finished it with my fingers.
[lowtech] Ate the meat raw off the bone. The fire had gone out.
[winter] Roast and gravy on a freezing night. I couldn't have asked for better.
[trait:Ascetic] A lavish supper. I ate a plain part of it and left the rest for the others.
[winter] Slept outside in the cold and woke up as stiff as a plank.
[skill:Plants] It's been days since I touched soil. My hands miss it.
[winter] There's a frozen body in the snow by the gate. It's been there for days.
[lowtech] Drums and singing in the hall tonight. I danced until I was dizzy.
[winter] A party in the middle of winter, and the hall was warm for once.
[bad] {OTHER_nameDef} and I came to blows over nothing. My jaw still aches.
